title: Aliases and back-links for agents/policy-as-code (OPA, Verified Permissions)
goal: _tools/aliases.csv holds the rows 'open policy agent,opa', 'opa,opa', 'amazon verified permissions,verified permissions', 'avp,verified permissions' and 'verified permissions,verified permissions', and the Reference sections of kb/public/agents/agent-rbac.md and kb/public/agents/gitops-for-agents.md name agents/policy-as-code.md

run: import csv,pathlib,sys; r={tuple(x) for x in csv.reader(open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8'))}; w={('open policy agent','opa'),('opa','opa'),('amazon verified permissions','verified permissions'),('avp','verified permissions'),('verified permissions','verified permissions')}; l=all('agents/policy-as-code.md' in pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in ('kb/public/agents/agent-rbac.md','kb/public/agents/gitops-for-agents.md')); sys.exit(0 if w<=r and l else 1)
